title: Saturday Expedition
description:
Meet at the Car park for a 09:00am start. A circular route starting in Winchcombe. About 15km with approximately 450m elevation. 

This is a lovely Cotswold route with ancient burial ground, Roman Villa and Norman Castle (I think) along the way. It has some 'lovely' elevations but we'll tackle these however we feel on the day. 

There's a lovely coffee shop which Sarah A and I rested out so all should be good! 

Train shoes required and bring water and whatever are you nutrition requiements. 
Please click out / keep in touch so that our start is prompt. Thank you. 

LiRF: Julie Slack [Phone Number Redacted]
location: Winchcombe Back Lane Car Park, Back Ln, Cheltenham, GL54 5PZ, United Kingdom

title: Cross Country Training
description: Meet by the Buzzards in Rosebank. Warm up jog down to Common. Then a series of loops/hill interval efforts on the Buzzard XC course. title: 🧹 Wyche 2: Return Of The Wyche
description:
🏃We'll run to British camp and back.

⛰️ At the end, an option to run up to the beacon and back for those that want a challenge!

📏 Around 8k/140m in ~50m, +3k/160m in however long it takes if you want to go to the beacon. 

♥️ Nobody left behind - I'll ensure the group stays together, so if you need to slow down please do so! For context: it's often me who needs to slow down 😂

⚠️ Safety stuff
- Headlight required, ensure it's charged!
- High viz recommended
- It will be slippy, rocky, muddy and potentially wet - so be prepared!
